# Weekly Clinic Visits: Presentation-Ready Snapshot

A simple **line chart** and a **stacked bar chart** are the best fit here for non-technical managers. Together they show both the **trend over time** and the **mix of visit types** each week.

## Recommended Charts and What They Show

### 1) Trend Line Chart
Use one line each for Flu, Allergy, Injury, and Checkup across the 4 weeks.

- **Best for:** spotting rises, dips, and the most stable visit type
- **What it shows:** Checkups stay highest overall, Allergy rises in the last week, Flu peaks mid-month, and Injury stays lowest and fairly steady
- **Manager takeaway:** good for answering “What changed week to week?”

### 2) Stacked Bar Chart
Use one stacked bar per week, with the four visit types stacked inside each bar.

- **Best for:** showing total weekly volume and category mix together
- **What it shows:** total visits are highest in the third and fourth weeks, and Checkups make up the largest share every week
- **Manager takeaway:** good for answering “How busy was the clinic, and what drove the volume?”

## Weekly Visit Data for Charting

Week | Flu | Allergy | Injury | Checkup | Total
2026-01-05 | 18 | 24 | 9 | 31 | 82
2026-01-12 | 16 | 29 | 11 | 28 | 84
2026-01-19 | 21 | 26 | 8 | 35 | 90
2026-01-26 | 19 | 30 | 10 | 33 | 92

## Main Insights

- **Checkups are the largest visit type every week**, ranging from 28 to 35.
- **Total clinic visits increase over the month** from 82 to 92, suggesting a moderate upward trend.
- **Allergy visits trend upward overall**, ending at the highest level in the final week.
- **Injury visits are the smallest and most stable category**, with only minor variation.

## Caution on Interpretation

This is only **4 weeks of data**, so it is best for a short-term snapshot, not a seasonal or long-term trend. Also, the counts are **raw visit numbers**, so changes could reflect scheduling, staffing, weather, or reporting patterns rather than true demand shifts.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build line chart] https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+create+a+line+chart+in+excel
Action: [Button: Build stacked bar] https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+create+a+stacked+bar+chart+in+excel

## Sources

- Chart selection guidance: https://www.data-to-viz.com/
- Excel chart basics: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel
